scenes.headline: Trailmix: a boot made for wet rock
scenes.narration: This is a sample launch for a fictional boot. It is called Trailmix, and it is built for slick stone.

scenes.headline: Grip where it matters
scenes.narration: Trailmix has a deep tread and a sticky heel edge, designed for slick stone and muddy descents.

scenes.headline: Dry day and wet day
scenes.narration: On a dry trail most boots feel fine. Wet rock is where a boot earns its price.

scenes.headline: Built for the long day
scenes.narration: A cushioned midsole, a roomy toe box and a waterproof liner.

scenes.headline: Weight
scenes.narration: At nine hundred grams a pair, it is light enough to forget.

scenes.headline: A fictional boot
scenes.narration: Trailmix is made up, used here to show what a launch video can look like.
